headline: The fighting now is Saudi-Houthi. Houthi missiles hit Riyadh's airport on Oct 8 (3 Saudis killed) and Oct 10 (12 killed, 309 wounded, including one American) (#1339, #1340).

Asked on Oct 10 whether the US would join Saudi strikes, Trump said 'We may. We're going to look at it' (#1341). A Houthi official warned of 'a swift and painful response' on the US if it does (#1342).

The log shows no US strike on the Houthis since the May 6, 2025 ceasefire (#1319). US advisers are in Saudi Arabia giving intelligence and targeting help (#1335), and US and Houthi officials met in Muscat on Sep 12-13 (#1337).
No Houthi attack on US forces or on non-Saudi shipping is logged since Sep 29, 2025. The last Treasury round was Jan 16, 2026 (#1329).
